description: This is a Python source file implementing a voice assistant bot using Pipecat framework, integrating speech-to-text, language model, and transport layers, with functions for conversation management and weather info.

classes.name: SessionProperties
classes.description: Holds session configuration for the OpenAIRealtimeBetaLLMService, including audio input and instructions.

classes.name: AudioConfiguration
classes.description: Configures audio input settings for the session.

classes.name: AudioInput
classes.description: Specifies audio input parameters, including transcription and turn detection.

classes.name: DeepgramSTTService
classes.description: Speech-to-text service implementation using Deepgram API.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeBetaLLMService
classes.description: Language model service with real-time OpenAI beta features.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines a sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline tasks.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a specific pipeline execution with parameters.

classes.name: OpenAILLMContext
classes.description: Context object for managing conversation state and tools.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class for transport layer implementations.

classes.name: DailyParams
classes.description: Transport parameters for daily transport with VAD analyzer.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Transport parameters for WebSocket via FastAPI with VAD analyzer.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api
methods.description: Fetches weather info based on format argument and returns via callback.

methods.name: get_saved_conversation_filenames
methods.description: Retrieves list of saved conversation filenames matching pattern.

methods.name: save_conversation
methods.description: Saves current conversation messages to a timestamped JSON file.

methods.name: load_conversation
methods.description: Loads conversation messages from specified filename and resets conversation.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Initializes and runs the bot with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point to start the bot, creating transport and running it.
